Clip Timing & On-the-Fly Subtitle Builder

Control how incoming audio bytes from whisper-cli are mapped onto the video timeline and exported to .srt

Use whisper-cli's exact first-byte (clipStartMs) and last-byte (clipEndMs) audio timestamps and finalization lag instead of guessing duration from character count. Locks start time on the first spoken syllable even if started mid-sentence.
Cut subtitles at each sentence boundary (., !, ?, 。, ！, ？) so rapid back-to-back dialogue or arguments without pauses become separate scrubbable sentences instead of one long block.
Build an in-memory timeline of every subtitle's exact video start and end timestamps as you watch for instant replay seeking and properly timed episode .srt exports.
Lock finalized subtitle lines onto the video timeline so scrubbing back and forth replays your existing subtitles right as the line starts without re-transcribing or duplicating them.
Display a floating 🔄 Re-record Line button when the video is paused (or press Alt+R) to uncement that specific line, rewind to its start, and re-capture it cleanly.
Display a floating ⏮ Prev button above the subtitle when the video is paused and an earlier subtitle exists on the timeline.
Display a floating Next ⏭ button above the subtitle when the video is paused and a cemented subtitle exists ahead of you on the timeline.
When you rewind or replay a line (or resume after pausing mid-sentence), automatically merge or replace the overlapping fragment on the video timeline so your final .srt file has clean, non-overlapping subtitles.
Extra lead-in padding subtracted before the first detected audio byte when stamping subtitle start time.
Extra trail-out padding added after the last detected audio byte when stamping subtitle end time.

Video Playback & External Audio Filtering

Prevent Anki card audio, Yomitan lookups, or other tabs from interfering when your video is paused

Ignore any new system audio transcribed while the target video is paused (such as Anki card audio or word repetitions) so it never overwrites the paused subtitle on screen or pollutes your episode's .srt history.
Keep the currently displayed subtitle frozen on screen for as long as the video is paused so you can highlight words or mine sentences without it fading out.
Automatically detect and attach the subtitle overlay to the largest / currently playing HTML5 video element on the page.
⏪

Smart Replay Navigation (asbplayer Style)

Instant keyboard seeking to the exact beginning of spoken lines

Intercept the Left Arrow key on video players to jump directly to the start of the current or previous subtitle instead of the player's default 5s/10s jump.
When you've rewound and a cemented subtitle exists ahead of you on the timeline, press Right Arrow (→) to jump directly to the next subtitle (falls back to normal player fast-forward when caught up).
If the video is paused when you press Left Arrow (←), automatically start playback from the beginning of the subtitle.
How many milliseconds before the subtitle's start timestamp to land when seeking with Left Arrow (←).
